content.text: I fixed the bug in `solution/util.py`, and all 3 visible tests now pass. The `_NAME` regex ended in a lazy quantifier (`*?`), so it matched only the first character of a placeholder name. `core.py` then saw a name that wasn't followed by `}` and raised "malformed placeholder". Changing it to a greedy `*` fixed it. I didn't touch `core.py` or anything under `tests/`.

Changing it to a greedy `*` fixed it. I didn't touch `core.py` or anything under `tests/`.
